reviews.title: Poor moderation great addons
reviews.text:
Craft Craft has some genuinely good content. The addons, skins, and maps are usually legitimate, and I’ve found some fun creations that actually work.

Unfortunately, the app has several major problems. The post feature feels clunky and confusing, and there are people who troll or spam instead of posting useful content.

The biggest issue is moderation. Within my first five minutes of using the app, I came across explicit pornographic content. That should never happen on an app like this, especially when younger players are likely to use it. It makes the platform feel unsafe and poorly managed.

If the developers improved moderation and cleaned up the community posts, this app could be much better. Right now, the quality content is overshadowed by the lack of moderation.

reviews.title: An app once good, but now full of NSFW content and AI slop.
reviews.text:
Hello. I know this will get replied by an AI bot, but I want to address a few things that some people are thinking before buying this considering the negativity you will see in critical reviews

Q: is there really nsfw content on this app?

A:Yes. Within 10 minutes I was exposed to nsfw content due to poor moderation.


Q: Does this app require a subscription service?

A: No. Although, there are a lot of advertisements without the subscription, you can earn enough gems to turn off all forced advertising without having to pay at all. This is actually very valid for the creators and I see why they did this. Keeping crafty craft up after like 6 years (I think) is insane considering they live off of $3/week subscriptions and advertising.


Q: Can you make mods and skins with this app?

A: Yes. The ui, designing, and modding part of this app is very user friendly 


Q: what do you mean by AI slop?

A: I mean most advertisements and modern events use AI for everything. It feels more like detachment since the developers don’t care enough about crafty craft to actually write and draw their things



So why is this 2 stars? Well, it USED to be amazing. I’ve been using this app on and off since basically the start and I’ve seen basically it all. My biggest problems are the asset ripping, poor moderation, and bots. Nowadays there are several bots posting nsfw stuff all the time. If the crafty craft devs moderated the bots, then it’d be 5 stars (as well as fix the nsfw portions)
